title: About us
description: Learn the purpose and editorial approach behind Little Home Ideas.
body:
Why we're here

Small ideas. Better living.

We believe the most useful home ideas are clear, achievable and honest about what they can—and cannot—do.

Practical over perfect

Little Home Ideas is an independent, developing collection of home, garden and DIY inspiration for real spaces and budgets. We focus on small changes, renter-conscious options and helpful decision-making tools.

How we work

Articles may be drafted with AI assistance. We aim to review factual and safety-sensitive claims and to disclose when products have not been independently tested. Read our editorial policy.

Start exploring

Browse all ideas or try our patio privacy planner.

title: Privacy information
description: Privacy information for visitors to Little Home Ideas.
body:
Privacy information

Last updated: October 15, 2026.

Little Home Ideas publishes home and garden guides and provides a browser-based Patio & Balcony Layout Planner.

Hosting and technical logs

This website is served through GitHub Pages. GitHub may process IP addresses and request data to deliver the site, maintain security, and operate its services. See GitHub's privacy statement.

Optional Google Analytics

With your permission, we load Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, useful articles, and use of the planner. Before you choose Allow analytics, our consent controller does not load Google's analytics library or send analytics events. Rejecting analytics does not affect access to articles or tools.

After consent, Google receives information such as page visits, timestamps, browser and device information, referral sources, cookie identifiers, and technical request data including your IP address. Google processes this information according to its service settings and policies. Data may be processed outside your country. See Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from partner sites.

Our explicit events measure article opens, saved guides, scroll milestones, and planner start, completed layout, save, and print actions. Our custom events do not include floor dimensions, furniture positions, search text, email addresses, or other form answers. The page URLs sent by our code omit query strings and fragments. The Analytics stream may also collect automatic interaction events according to its settings.

Your choice and cookies

Choose Allow analytics or Reject analytics in the banner. We remember your choice in this browser's local storage for up to 180 days. You can reopen Analytics choices in the footer to change it. Withdrawing permission stops our analytics collection, removes accessible Google Analytics cookies, and reloads the page. Withdrawal does not erase data already collected by Google.

After permission, Google Analytics uses cookies such as _ga and a property-specific _ga cookie to distinguish visits and sessions. Our tag requests a 180-day cookie lifetime without extending it on each visit; your browser may apply a shorter lifetime. Advertising storage, advertising user data, and advertising personalization are denied by our integration. We do not enable Google Signals. No advertising or affiliate tracking scripts have been installed by us.

Planner, search, and saved ideas

The planner calculations and site search run locally. Our custom analytics events report tool actions, not the values you enter. Saved article identifiers and your analytics preference are stored on your device. Saved ideas are not synchronized between devices. Remove a saved guide with its bookmark button, or clear website storage in your browser settings. Clearing the analytics preference makes the site ask again.

Operator and contact details

The operator's public identification and dedicated privacy contact have not yet been supplied. This information page will be updated when those details are provided; it is not a complete legal privacy notice.

title: Advertising & affiliate disclosure
description: Current advertising and affiliate disclosure for Little Home Ideas.
body:
Transparency

Advertising & affiliate disclosure

How commercial relationships will be handled on this website.

Current status

As of October 13, 2026, this initial version of Little Home Ideas does not contain affiliate links or paid advertising placements.

Future affiliate links

Some future articles may contain links that earn a commission if you make a qualifying purchase. When that happens, we'll identify those relationships clearly near the relevant content. The price you pay is generally determined by the retailer, not by us.

Editorial independence

Paid relationships must not be presented as independent product testing. See our editorial policy.

title: Editorial policy
description: How Little Home Ideas develops practical and responsible home and garden content.
body:
Our editorial approach

We want home improvement ideas to be useful, clear about limitations, and practical for real budgets and living situations.

What we aim to publish

Step-by-step explanations, comparisons, design inspiration and small interactive tools. We distinguish general suggestions from claims that require measurements, expert review or real-world testing.

Safety first

Projects involving structural loads, electricity, plumbing, elevated balconies, building codes or other significant hazards may require permission or professional guidance. Our content is not a substitute for qualified advice.

Product and price claims

We do not describe products as personally tested unless that testing actually occurred. Indicative prices, when included, should be dated and supported by current sources. Readers should verify availability and compatibility independently.

AI-assisted drafting

Drafting and research may be assisted by AI. Material facts, safety claims, sources and editorial quality should be reviewed before publication. We will correct significant errors when identified.

Advertising and affiliate relationships

We currently have no affiliate links or advertisements in this initial version. If these are added, we will clearly disclose commercial relationships and keep editorial recommendations separate from paid placements.

Images and illustrations

Some decorative images, including decorative interior, bathroom, patio, plant, and kitchen scenes, are created with AI. They illustrate ideas and do not document a real project, product test, or before-and-after result. Our planning diagrams are original illustrations and are not to scale. We do not use generated images as evidence of a tested result.
